LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Novice_1: {PAWN} delivered a satchel of medicine to a settlement that had run dry, and made it back before dark.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Novice_2: {PAWN} treated a handful of minor wounds on the road and turned down payment for it.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Novice_3: {PAWN} spent the trip teaching a settlement's own healer a few things worth knowing.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Novice_4: {PAWN} talked a nervous settlement into letting the chapter set up a supply route.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Veteran_1: {PAWN} got a settlement's outbreak under control before it could spread any further.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Veteran_2: {PAWN} spent the trip treating the wounded from a raid, working through the night more than once.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Veteran_3: {PAWN} came back with a full case of records worth adding to the chapter archive.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Veteran_4: {PAWN} talked a hostile checkpoint down without a shot fired, medicine in hand the whole way.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a full convoy would have drawn too much attention, and came back with everyone alive.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the quarantine exactly to protocol, in, treat, out, no one else exposed.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks off the charter's known routes and came back with knowledge worth the risk.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what was out there, just filed the report and asked what's needed next.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past any ground the chapter has ever charted, scouting for the next place that needs help.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed territory with word of a settlement ready to host a chapter of its own.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with news the administrator will want to hear directly.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Followers_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back through the chapter doors carrying proof of what was found at the edge of the map, worn through but every patient still breathing.
